scope: robolab BananasOutOfBinTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (out_of_container); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read BananasOutOfBinTask terminations: success = object_outside_of(object=['banana_02', 'banana_04'], container='grey_bin', logical='all', tolerance=0.0, require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene bananas_5_grey_bin.usda: banana_02, banana_04, grey_bin among 7 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only. At reset two bananas start inside the grey bin; the termination names exactly those two.

assets_and_frames.basis: Not in the container's open-top hull (centroid test in the container frame).

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (3) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 08f3f1eaa44c).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 08f3f1eaa44c): out -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_outside_of(object=['banana_02', 'banana_04'], container='grey_bin', logical='all', tolerance=0.0, require_gripper_detached=True): not in_opentop_container (hull centroid outside the open-top hull).
require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks that no gripper body touches the object above 0.1 N.
conditions.interpretation: Release: the gripper touches none of the named objects.
Hull slack and contact force bar withheld.

public_clauses: Both bananas that start in the grey bin must end up out of it.
Let go of each of them: the task is not complete while the gripper still touches either one.

counterexamples.case: Objects in place while one is still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
